faqs.question: How do I choose the right jewellery for me?
faqs.answer: Our jewellery is designed for different styles and occasions. You can explore our collections by jewellery type, metal, gemstone, and occasion to find a piece that suits your personal style.

faqs.question: Are your diamonds and gemstones certified?
faqs.answer: Yes. Selected diamond and gemstone jewellery comes with the relevant certification and authenticity details. Product-specific certification information is mentioned on the product page.

faqs.question: When will I receive my order?
faqs.answer: Orders are carefully packed and dispatched after confirmation. Delivery time depends on your location and the product. You can check the estimated delivery time during checkout.

faqs.question: Do you offer free shipping?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer free shipping on eligible orders. Shipping availability and charges may vary depending on the order value and delivery location.

faqs.question: Can I track my jewellery order?
faqs.answer: Yes. Once your order is dispatched, you will receive tracking details so you can easily follow your shipment.

faqs.question: Can I return or exchange my jewellery?
faqs.answer: Eligible products can be returned or exchanged according to our return and exchange policy. Please check the product-specific terms before placing your order.

faqs.question: How do I initiate a return or exchange?
faqs.answer: You can request a return or exchange through your account/order section or contact our customer support team with your order details.

faqs.question: Do you offer custom jewellery designs?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can help you create personalised jewellery based on your preferred design, gemstone, metal, size, and style. Contact our team to discuss your requirements.

faqs.question: Can I customise a ring or necklace?
faqs.answer: Yes, selected designs can be customised. Availability depends on the jewellery design and requested modifications.

data.title: How can we help you?
data.subtitle: Jewellery FAQs
data.heroDescription: Answers on jewellery care, sizing, orders, and returns — plus direct access to our team when you need a human touch.

items.q: Are your diamonds and gemstones ethically sourced?
items.a: Yes. We use conflict-free, responsibly sourced diamonds and gemstones. Product pages list metal purity and stone details where available.

items.q: How should I care for my jewellery?
items.a: Store pieces separately, avoid harsh chemicals and perfume spray on metal, and wipe gently with a soft cloth after wear. Lifetime shine warranty covers polish guidance for eligible pieces.

items.q: How do I choose the right ring size?
items.a: Use our size guide on ring product pages, or visit a local jeweller for a precise measurement. Contact support if you need help selecting a size before purchase.
Yes. Every piece is crafted and quality-checked by our team before it reaches you.

items.q: When will I receive my order?
items.a: Orders typically ship within 1–2 business days. Delivery usually takes 3–5 business days across India; metro cities often arrive sooner.

items.q: How can I track my order?
items.a: Once shipped, you will receive tracking via email and SMS. You can also view live status under My Orders in your account.
Yes — complimentary insured shipping on orders above ₹599. Fees for smaller orders are shown at checkout.

items.q: Can I change my delivery address?
items.a: Contact us within 2 hours of placing your order if it has not shipped yet. After dispatch, address changes depend on the courier and your PIN code.
Eligible jewellery may be returned or exchanged within 7 days of delivery when unused and in original packaging. Custom or engraved pieces may be final sale.

items.q: What if the size does not fit?
items.a: Contact us within 48 hours of delivery with your order number. We will arrange an exchange for an available size where possible.

items.q: How do I initiate a return?
items.a: Open My Orders, select the order, and tap Return or Exchange. We schedule a doorstep pickup in most serviceable PIN codes within 2 business days.

items.q: When will I receive my refund?
items.a: Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days after we receive and inspect the returned item, credited to your original payment method.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking, popular wallets, and Cash on Delivery (COD) on eligible PIN codes.
COD is available on eligible PIN codes and order values. Availability is confirmed at checkout.
Yes. We use SSL encryption and a PCI-DSS compliant payment gateway. We never store your full card details on our servers.

items.a: Sign in with OTP to unlock member offers, faster checkout, and order tracking.
